verdict.rationale: The official README says Gemini CLI can 'query and edit large codebases', debug and troubleshoot issues in natural language, and generate new apps (gh-1, gh-3, gh-2), and one user reports it navigates very large codebases effortlessly (comm-1). Other users concretely contradict this with hands-on failures: it fails at edit and read tool calls and loops on errors (comm-10), rewrites files as empty (comm-11), is 'useless as a coding assistant' beyond simple tasks and lacks a plan mode (comm-14), and navigates codebases poorly (comm-15). Missing for 10: first-party documentation of multi-file edit workflows from plain-language feature or bug descriptions, and consistent independent corroboration of reliable multi-file implementation.
